answer_1.quote: We select the chatbots for our study ... Interactors are asked to rate 8 dimensions ... of each conversation ... Our final conversation dataset includes 400 human-bot dialogues (100 dialogues per chatbot), averaging 30.3 turns per dialogue.

answer_2.quote: Since existing automatic evaluation metrics have been shown to be biased measures of chat quality ... evaluation using human judgments is standard, although the type of human judgments varies widely across works.

answer_4.quote: 10 students ... are invited to interact ... Interactors are asked to rate 8 dimensions ... on a 1-5 Likert scale, and to select the higher-quality conversation ... ABC-Eval Annotators provide binary labels on the turn-level indicating the presence or absence of a particular chat characteristic.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each conversation on 8 dimensions using a 1-5 Likert scale; annotate binary behavior labels per turn.
